machine.note: Measured under load: other jobs were training models on the same machine (system CPU use 27-100% during the run). Loop and tensor are timed back to back and the medians of 5 passes are shown, so the ratios hold up better than the absolute times; three separate runs gave CPU speed-ups that differed by up to ~3x at the same size. GPU timings are float64 (a GTX 1080 Ti runs float64 at 1/32 of its float32 rate) and exclude host-to-device copies.

dot.tensor:
def dot_tensor(x, y):
    return torch.dot(x, y)  # or torch.einsum("i,i->", x, y)

matmul.tensor:
def matmul_tensor(A, B):
    return A @ B  # or torch.einsum("ik,kj->ij", A, B)

diffusion.tensor:
def diffusion_tensor(u, a=0.2):
    new = u.clone()
    c = u[1:-1, 1:-1]
    lap = u[2:, 1:-1] + u[:-2, 1:-1] + u[1:-1, 2:] + u[1:-1, :-2] - 4 * c
    new[1:-1, 1:-1] = c + a * lap
    return new
